description: Create a synchronized clip transport container: a Movie File In TOP video lane, optional Audio File In CHOP lane, Null outputs, deterministic layout, and Play/Loop/Speed controls bound across both lanes. Use it as a reusable building block before clip launchers, VJ decks, or stream/output chains.

audio_file.description: Optional audio file path for the Audio File In CHOP.

autoplay.description: Initial play state for movie/audio file inputs.

expose_controls.description: Expose Play, Loop and Speed custom parameters on the transport container.

include_audio.description: Create an Audio File In CHOP transport lane alongside the movie lane.

loop.description: Initial loop state for movie/audio file inputs.

movie_file.description: Optional movie file path for the Movie File In TOP.

name.description: Name of the transport container COMP to create.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path where the transport container is created.

speed.description: Initial playback speed. Negative values reverse where the operator supports it.

name: clip_audio_transport
title: Clip/audio transport
